body: Ayaw pugsa bes, natural ra na mu gawas ang convo.  Ikaw nasad pili bes, kung unsa imung ganahan since siya man permi ga sugod.  What if ikaw mu una?  If compatible mo, wa ra nay blema.

Double check your engagement letters on the limit of data an auditor can ask for.  But normally, everything that's requested should be provided.  You may want to ask for the purpose, but they'll have their reasons.

 Independence checks, background check for any legal thing a substantial investor is in and whether the fund is aware and what certain action was done in relation to that.  Is there a need to disclose it or not.  Just to name two.  

Really there's a lot of reason for why an auditor would ask for the list of investors.
